review_evidence: README explicitly states that the library provides formalized mathematics for formally verifying cryptographic implementations.
Nine of 11 Lean files contain proposition declarations, including Montgomery and Barrett reduction specifications, modular-arithmetic equivalences and ML-KEM correctness examples.
Representative MontgomeryReduction.lean proves bounds and reduction specifications; this is direct verification-oriented prior art.
summary: Reviewed lean-cryptolib; retain the cryptographic arithmetic specification and proof library.
